verses: I also saw the souls of women who ever shed and sucked and ate the blood and filth of their ten fingers; and worms ever came into both eyes.
And I asked thus: 'Who are these souls? and what sin was committed by them who suffer so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those wicked women who beautified their faces with makeup, and kept the hair of others as ornament; and they captivated the eyes of the men of God.'
